newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: BANK OF NOVA SCOTIA IN VENEZUELAN DEAL.
newsitem.headline: BANK OF NOVA SCOTIA IN VENEZUELAN DEAL.

text.p: Canada's Bank of Nova Scotia plans to take a 25 percent stake in Venezuela's Banco del Caribe before the end of the year, the head of the Venezuelan bank said.
"We hope to reach an agreement before the end of 1997. Many details still have to be worked out ... but we've already gone a long way," Edgar Dao told Reuters.
The deal would be through a capital increase, Dao said. He provided no figures but said Banco del Caribe is a family-owned, middle-sized bank with assets of 35 billion bolivars ($71 million).
Toronto-based Bank of Nova Scotia was authorized last month to open a Caracas office.
